build_transformer_encoder_layer: build a TransformerEncoderLayer with self-attention and FFN using fairseq args for encoder configuration
build_transformer_decoder_layer: build a TransformerDecoderLayer with self-attention, encoder attention, and FFN using fairseq args
run_encoder_forward_pass: run a forward pass through TransformerEncoderLayer with input tensor and padding mask
